general_implementation.reason: Preferred default for substantive implementation at the user’s request; retain bounded ownership and explicit integration acceptance.

narrow_mechanical.reason: Clear, repeatable changes with little ambiguity; assess reasoning work separately.

bounded_or_read_heavy.reason: Preferred route for bounded implementation and investigations; lower effort remains available for clearly routine work with a recorded reason.

complex_implementation.reason: Use when a concrete cross-component judgment, concurrency/scheduling, or hard-debugging requirement warrants Sol instead of preferred Terra high; complexity or size alone does not trigger escalation.

clear_contract_reasoning.reason: Provisional candidate for self-contained reasoning with a clear contract, limited coupling, and independently checkable acceptance.

dense_local_rules.reason: Dense local business rules or state transitions within a clear ownership and integration boundary.

measurement_policy: Unknown usage stays null. Compare similar tasks accepted against comparable quality contracts; include implementation, functional and quality corrections, and attributable coordinator review. Keep shared setup overhead separate. Functional pass cost is not final quality acceptance cost. Routing defaults remain hypotheses.
logging_access: Request directory-scoped access once per session when needed; reuse grants, otherwise use the authorized workspace fallback and retain the run root.

work_scheduling.integration_milestones: Small behavioral slices with explicit ownership, prerequisites, and acceptance evidence; first prove the production boundary, then accept each lifecycle/consumer slice before releasing dependents.
work_scheduling.repeated_boundary_failure: After two unsuccessful corrections on the same boundary, diagnose contract, fixture, or ownership and narrow/replan the milestone before further patches.

execution_evidence.early_persistence_recovery_gate: Before broad implementation, verify an isolated real production write-read-recreate or close-reopen boundary and relevant failure/retry path; mocks alone do not pass. Missing environment leaves the affected milestone unverified.

preferred_worker.basis: Explicit user preference; not an inferred telemetry cost or quality ranking.
preferred_worker.exceptions: Keep Luna for narrow mechanical work; choose Sol or another effort only with a concrete task-specific reason.
